review_method: All 45 local material, door and architecture images compared in labelled contact sheets; six matching Godot before/after views and nine door families in closed/open states.

useful_reference_mapping.architecture_pack_2_boards_5_13: Cylinder sconces, ring flush fixtures, suspended chandelier; light_fixture.gd
useful_reference_mapping.door_boards_1_to_9: Layered jamb/casing profiles, applied gothic panels, hinges, lever/pull/lock hardware, service porthole/push plate, cyan spine, green access/number modules; scripts/door_visual.gd
useful_reference_mapping.architecture_pack_2_boards_1_11: Inset wainscot, stepped profiles, crown/dado/skirting; interior_kit.gd and hero_visuals.gd
useful_reference_mapping.architecture_pack_2_boards_3_12: Coffered ceilings and nested trim; interior_kit.gd
useful_reference_mapping.material_boards_1_2_3_10_11: Normal surface palette, dark glass/cloth and controlled practical light balance
useful_reference_mapping.nightmare_and_damage_boards: Classified and retained for future work; no normal-state corruption activated
useful_reference_mapping.architecture_pack_2_board_7: Literal rebuilt plaques/access panels; no generated lettering
useful_reference_mapping.architecture_pack_2_boards_4: Smoked/frosted and applied stained-glass vocabulary; hero_visuals.gd and door_visual.gd
useful_reference_mapping.architecture_pack_2_boards_2_6_14: Dark floor finishes, brass inlay, burgundy runners, walnut and upholstery palette; shared materials

limitations: Approved rectangular apertures and leaf dimensions preserved. Gothic arches are applied moulding and shallow crowns, not new arched openings.
Opaque stylised smoked/frosted glass is used on backed decorative panels; no new architectural openings.
Framed artwork remains owned procedural placeholder art; no production portrait images were extracted.
Source decal/screen/VFX sheets require Photoshop cleanup before direct use.
